name: June 4 2025 Regular Meeting - Notice of Adjournment
agenda_text:
Notice of Adjournment
  Malibu Public Safety Commission
  Regular Meeting

Please take notice the Regular Meeting of the Public Safety Commission scheduled
for Wednesday, June 4th, 2025 was adjourned due to lack of a quorum.

The adjourned regular meeting will be held on June 5, 2025 at 1:00 p.m. in the Multi-
Purpose Room at City Hall, 23825 Stuart Ranch Road, Malibu, California 90265.

Should there be any questions regarding this notice, please contact Administrative
Assistant Tabbay at 310-456-2489, ext. 319, or at NTabbay@malibucity.org.

Dated: June 4th, 2025, at 3:45 p.m.

____________________________________
Noah Tyler Tabbay, Administrative Assistant
